# CGI Advantage Reporting Surfaces

| Surface | Scope | Use |
|---|---|---|
| CGI Advantage financial reports | Native operational and financial reporting | Reuse delivered shapes before custom extracts. |
| CGI Advantage Insight | Native analytics surface | Align warehouse and dashboard vocabulary to native reporting terms. |
| Trial Balance Inquiry | Interactive GL review | Use for low-latency balance validation. |
| Posting Line Inquiry | Transaction traceability | Use for drill-through and audit trace. |
| COA Crosswalk | Segment translation | Apply the same mapping in exports and analytics. |
| Batch and report jobs | Scheduled processing and distribution | Use for nightly, close-cycle, and high-volume output. |
| AP, AR, vendor, and PO domains | Subledger reporting | Join subledger identifiers to GL dimensions with explicit lineage. |
